Focus is tokens, primary/secondary buttons, data tables, and chart color semantics. migration_notes: Semantic renames: legacy token 'bg-accent-1' -> 'surface-cta' (reason: clarify purpose; remediation: replace in CSS tokens map and update component story)
Spacing tokens: 'space-lg' split into 'gap-lg' + 'stack-lg' to make layout intent explicit. Migration: map space-lg to gap-lg for grid and stack-lg for vertical stacks with a one-line helper script.
Color shifts: 'primary-600' becomes 'brand-600' and 'primary-500' becomes 'brand-500'. Add 'deprecated' suffix in token file for 2 releases before removal.
Button variants: 'btn-ghost' updated to 'button-ghost' prop change; migration: replace className string 'btn-ghost' with <Button variant="ghost"> and add import guidance.
Chart palettes: 'chart-default' replaced by explicit semantic sets: 'chart-qualitative', 'chart-sequential'. Migration: include mapping for each palette index to semantic tokens in CSV.
Tables: column sizing token 'col-md' renamed to 'col-fixed-md' to avoid confusion with responsive columns; remediation: search/replace and add note about new auto-layout prop.
Notes on deprecation window: default is two releases (approx 8 weeks). Add opt-in compatibility flag in dedicated builds as interim measure.
button_api_summary: New recommended Button props: <Button variant="primary|secondary|ghost|link" size="sm|md|lg" loading="boolean" disabled="boolean">
Do: Use semantic variants (primary/secondary) instead of color tokens directly on styles to ensure themeability
Don't: Chain tokens in inline styles (e.g., style="background: var(--primary-600)"). Use token-aware CSS classes or the Button API.
Migration tip: replace CSS class 'btn-primary' with <Button variant="primary"> and remove direct token references from component consumers
Accessibility: Ensure aria-pressed for toggle buttons and focus-visible outline preserved. Contrast must meet AA for normal text (4.5:1) for buttons with text labels
table_api_summary: Table props overview: columns: Array<{key, header, width?}>, rowKey, density="comfortable|compact", stickyHeader="boolean"
Do: Provide explicit 'rowKey' when rows are dynamic. Avoid index-based keys to prevent reorder issues
Don't: Rely on CSS classes to provide alignment; prefer the column 'align' property to maintain consistent semantics
Migration note: legacy 'col-md' and 'col-fluid' tokens map to new width strategies. Add example of converting responsive CSS to column descriptors
chart_guidelines: Prefer semantic palette tokens (e.g., chart-qualitative-01) over hard-coded hex values so themes and dark mode behave predictably
Do: Use saturation or opacity tokens for layering (e.g., chart-fill-20) rather than mutating base hexes in code
Don't: Encode dataset meaning by color alone; always pair with shapes or labels for accessibility
Migration pattern: map old palette indexes to semantic tokens and include a migration function snippet for Chart.js / Vega adapters
examples:
Table example (JSX):
<Table columns={[{key:'id', header:'ID', width:80}, {key:'name', header:'Name'}]} rowKey="id" density="compact" />

Note: replace responsive CSS rules with column descriptors for predictability.

Bad example (do not copy):
Primary banner
Why: hard-coded hex prevents theme swapping and creates maintenance burden
